finding: Typed Entry has already entered the selected RFC8785/JCS identity generation, but the same-head router neither consumes nor validates entry_canonicalization_schema and continues to use its implementation-scoped Python JSON identity. The current inference receipt inherits that router serializer. Therefore selected Entry canonicalization is only partially wired and the required mixed/unknown/downgrade canonicalization rejection is not yet enforced at the router/receipt boundary.
counterhypothesis: The independent admission-to-event registry is sufficient to establish the canonicalizer version implicitly.
reason: The observed router registry value is an admission digest mapped to an event digest; no canonicalization schema/version is carried in that authority value or checked by the router. Schema provenance therefore cannot be inferred solely from the two hashes without an independently typed/versioned registry contract.
required_repair_order: Require selected entry_canonicalization_schema on the new current typed-entry route path; missing, unknown or legacy versions fail closed while historical identities remain explicitly historical/migration-scoped.
Migrate router policy, engine and route hashing to RFC8785/JCS under new versioned identity schemas; do not silently reinterpret HCU_CAUSAL_ROUTE_IDENTITY/v3 or other historical hashes.
Carry and echo the selected canonicalization schema through RouteDecision and migrate the single inference receipt producer to a new versioned receipt identity using the same selected JCS bytes.
Add deterministic regressions for missing schema, legacy schema, unknown schema, route/receipt downgrade and one valid Entry-v2 -> new-route -> new-receipt chain.
Then run the combined Entry -> route -> inference receipt -> GRID10 path on an actually-started authorized isolated executor before any runtime promotion.

coordination.note: No unusual experiment is claimed by this source audit. No-ID nearby receipts are not treated as one shared macrocycle solely by timestamp proximity.

related_current_main_evidence.note: Pre-load hashing alone is not loader attestation; physical loader lease/consumed-byte binding remains a downstream runtime gate after identity convergence.

next_exact_gate: Finish the single selected RFC8785/JCS identity path through router and inference receipt with versioned fail-closed downgrade checks, then execute the exact combined Entry/route/receipt/GRID10 chain on an authorized isolated executor and only afterward bind loader-consumed checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime bytes to physical engine leases.
